entry.title: MPC Sample Scale Mode 1.1.0
entry.summary: **MPC Sample Scale Mode** (was Enable Scale Mode). **Hold 16 Levels** (about a second) to turn Scale on or off. With Scale on, the 16 Levels slots play a scale instead of their usual steps. A short press is still a normal 16 Levels press, and Shift+16 Levels still cycles the Type. ![The SCALE page](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/jacob-sabella/mpc-addin-sample-scalemode/7f5c90324dbc6f3458eb17466a265d5992d2fade/docs/screenshots/scale-page.png) Holding 16 Levels also opens a **SCALE page**.
